description: Get a live price quote for a Premier Letters order. Pass char_count (or letter_count for a rough estimate) plus optional mailing_option and paper_type to get a per-piece and total price, in cents. No account needed. Orders under 5 pieces carry a $0.99 per-piece handling fee (included in total_cents), waived when paid from a prepaid balance. Pass output_mode (printed_bw / printed_color, or facsimile for the handwriting printed on a laser printer) to quote a printed letter body instead of a pen-written one, and envelope_output_mode to quote a printed envelope. Or pass tier (luxe = letter and envelope written with a real pen; signature = pen-addressed envelope with a printed-handwriting letter; essential = printed handwriting throughout; print = printed type) and/or mailing (a whole built mailing: contents such as coupons, flyers, business cards; add-ons such as wax seals or QR codes; paper and envelope stock) to price it line by line. Every response lists the tiers with their per-piece price.

char_count.description: Length of the letter message in characters. Longer letters cost more (character meter).

envelope_output_mode.description: Omit (or null) for a hand-addressed envelope, the default. facsimile prints the handwritten addressing; printed_bw / printed_color print typed addressing.

envelope_stock.description: Envelope stock: "standard" (white, included), "premium_white" or "premium_cream". Defaults to "standard". Ignored for postcards.

letter_count.description: Number of recipients / pieces. Defaults to 1.

mailing.description: A built mailing (same shape as the mailing field on create_order). Example: {"tier":"signature","contents":[{"item":"coupon","qty":1}],"addons":[{"id":"wax_seal"}]}. See /llms-full.txt "Build a mailing" for every item id.

mailing_option.description: Delivery option. Defaults to "we_mail" (we write, stamp, and mail it for you).

output_mode.description: Defaults to "handwritten". facsimile prints the handwriting layout on a laser printer; printed_bw / printed_color print typed text. The envelope stays hand-addressed unless envelope_output_mode is set.

paper_type.description: Letter paper stock. "standard" = white page (included), "premium_white" = premium white page, "premium" = premium cream page. Defaults to "standard". The response carries each stock's exact spec sheet (brand, item number, weight, thickness, brightness).

product_type.description: Product type (letter, card, postcard, etc). Informational only — does not change pricing components beyond envelope inclusion.

sheet_count.description: Sheets the letter runs to (preview_letter returns page_count). Long letters on heavier paper can pass 1 oz; every ounce over 1 adds the USPS extra-ounce rate when we mail it. Defaults to 1.

tier.description: Price a tier: luxe (Letter and envelope written with a real pen); signature (A real pen on the envelope, printed handwriting inside); essential (Printed handwriting, letter and envelope); print (Clean printed type).

name: get_pricing
